plain: The three goals of being helpful, honest and harmless, used to describe a well-behaved assistant.
eli5: Be useful, tell the truth, and do not hurt anyone.
technical: The assistant target framed by Askell et al. (2021); in Bai et al. (2022) an "HH" model is trained on both helpfulness and harmlessness labels, a "helpful" model on helpfulness labels only.
